settings.title: Place your stickers
settings.text: Lay your stickers between the two clear polycarbonate sheets. Arrange them however you want. No adhesive touches your MacBook — ever.

settings.title: Snap in the frame
settings.text: The hardshell border clips around your MacBook just like a standard case, holding the sheet sandwich firmly in place with full corner and edge protection.

settings.title: Swap or retire
settings.text: Pop the outer sheet to rearrange or replace your layout in 30 seconds. Retired sheets become framed objects — chapters of your life you can actually keep.

settings.title: UV-stabilized PC sheets
settings.text: Anti-yellowing, anti-fingerprint hard coat keeps stickers vivid for years.

settings.title: Swap in 30 seconds
settings.text: The outer sheet lifts out without removing the border. No tools, no drama.

settings.title: Zero MacBook contact
settings.text: No adhesive, no anodization risk. Remove it clean years from now.

settings.title: Wall-art ready
settings.text: Retired sheets fit standard frames. Every layout tells a chapter.

settings.title: Paper sticker friendly
settings.text: Enclosed from moisture, oils, and scuffs. Paper stickers finally protected.

settings.title: Case-quality protection
settings.text: Hardshell PC border. Corner drop protection. Same specs as premium cases.
